title: Berlin critères pour aigu Respiratory Distress syndrome
abbreviations: Berlin definition, berlin criteria, Berlin Criteria for Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome, Berlin Criteria for ARDS, ards, ards diagnosis, covid-19, coronavirus, covid, covid19, covid 19
formula:
Selection of the appropriate criteria:

| Berlin Criteria for ARDS |
| --- |
| Required criteria (must have all three of the following): |
| Timing within 1 week of clinical insult or new/worsening respiratory symptoms |
| Chest XR shows bilateral opacities not fully explained by effusions, lobar/lung collapse, or nodules |
| Respiratory failure not fully explained by cardiac failure/fluid overload |
| Risk factor (one of the following): |
| Risk factor for ARDS present (e.g. pneumonia, trauma, sepsis, pancreatitis) |
| Objective assessment (Echo) excludes hydrostatic edema |
| Severity (based on oxygenation, select one of the following): |
| Mild: [PaO₂/FiO₂](nabda:calc.horowitz-index-lung-function-p-f-ratio\) >200 to ≤300 mmHg with PEEP OR CPAP ≥5 cm H₂O |
| Moderate: PaO₂/FiO₂ >100 to ≤200 mmHg with PEEP ≥5 cm H₂O |
| Severe: PaO₂/FiO₂ ≤100 mmHg with PEEP ≥5 cm H₂O |

how_to_use.why:
- Fournit un cadre diagnostique standardisé pour le SDRA.
- La classification de la sévérité est corrélée aux critères de jugement cliniques (p. ex., mortalité, jours sans ventilation) et éclaire la stratification du risque.
how_to_use.when:
- À utiliser chez l’adulte présentant une insuffisance respiratoire aiguë hypoxémique pour diagnostiquer et évaluer la sévérité d’un syndrome de détresse respiratoire aiguë (SDRA) suspecté.
- À appliquer lorsque le patient est sous ventilation mécanique invasive ou non invasive avec une PEEP ou une CPAP ≥5 cm H₂O.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Developed by the ARDS Definition Task Force in 2012 to replace the 1994 American–European Consensus Conference (AECC) definition; the Berlin definition demonstrated better predictive validity for mortality than AECC.
- Exclude other causes of lung opacities such as primary cardiogenic pulmonary edema, isolated lobar pneumonia or atelectasis, and chronic interstitial lung disease flares.
- Requires arterial blood gas (ABG) to measure PaO₂, which may be unavailable in some settings.
- Does not include patients on high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC), which limits applicability in modern practice, especially in resource-limited settings.
- The[Kigali modification](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26352116/)(2016) is an adaptation centered on resource-limited environments: it does not require mechanical ventilation/PEEP or an ABG, allows use of the [SpO₂/FiO₂ ratio](nabda:calc.spo2-fio2-ratio) , and permits lung ultrasound when chest radiography is unavailable.
- The 2023 “[global definition](https://www.atsjournals.org/doi/10.1164/rccm.202303-0558WS)” of ARDS, endorsed by the American Thoracic Society, expands on the Berlin criteria to address many of its limitations.

next_steps.advice:
- Always interpret results in the context of clinical evaluation and expert input.
- Reassess ARDS severity throughout the patient’s clinical course as oxygenation and ventilatory needs evolve.
next_steps.management:
- For patients who **do not meet criteria** for ARDS:

 - Evaluate alternative diagnoses and contributing conditions.
 - Reassess if new data become available or if the patient’s clinical status changes.
- For patients who **meet criteria** for ARDS:

 - Initiate lung-protective ventilation: tidal volume 4–8 mL/kg predicted body weight (PBW), plateau pressure <30 cm H₂O, minimize driving pressure.
 - Consider a high-PEEP strategy, especially in moderate-to-severe cases.
 - Use prone positioning in moderate-to-severe ARDS.
 - If hemodynamically stable, adopt a conservative fluid management approach.
 - For refractory hypoxemia, consider ECMO in experienced centers; tools that may support further assessment include:

 - [Murray Score](nabda:calc.murray-score-acute-lung-injury)
 - [PRESET Score](nabda:calc.prediction-survival-ecmo-therapy-preset-score)
 - [RESP Score](nabda:calc.resp-respiratory-ecmo-survival-prediction-score)
